_brief: V2, 2026-10-04: recut to the line order Tal dictated after seeing V1 (TAL-NOTES-ROUND-1 row 5): the ask -> half a juice, really thirsty -> For free? -> Why did you help me? -> Thank you so much, what's your name -> Muslim / Jewish / brothers / One God -> the world tries to divide us ... we live together -> the reveal -> the refusal -> why don't you want the money -> you're so friendly -> this is life, giving back, spread positivity -> Inshallah, thank you bro -> slow-mo walk-off. The name / Muslim / Jewish / world-divides block was filmed BEFORE the ask (14-35s); it sits after the juice because that is the order he asked for. NO ZOOMS: every beat one constant framing. Cameras and sound as V1 (chest-cam POV sound throughout; iPhone = POV - 2.68s).
_framing: Every iPhone beat is ONE static 1.2 framing; only where the window sits differs, and it never moves inside a shot. Beat 6 (the name / Muslim / Jewish exchange, iPhone 12.9-23.6) keeps the window against the RIGHT edge: a boy stands at the left edge of the phone frame from 21.0s (LESSONS 81) and is outside it. The other iPhone beats (35-41, 57-59, 67-74, 93-97s) use the centred window so Tal is whole in frame - in the right-hand window his back was cut by the edge, and that would now be the first frame of the film. No child is in the phone frame during those beats (17 crops checked). The last beat sits against the LEFT edge for Tal walking off.
_left_out: V1 beats not in his order and removed: I'll give you this one, okay? / the second refusal in the two-shot (If you buy one, 15 shekel). 45-49s (it's not for me, it's my cousin's) stays out.

_hook: Tal asked to open on the owner saying "I am Muslim". No clean take of that exists: at 17.9-18.3 he answers Tal's salaam alaikum with a few syllables that one full-clip transcription wrote as I'm a Muslim and four narrow reads (two models, English and Arabic) wrote as Alatal / Alaykom / All right / an Arabic alaykum. So it is not captioned and not used as a hook, and the cut opens on the first line of his dictated order. It does NOT open on I'm Jewish.
_not_found: From his dictated lines: (1) the owner saying I am Muslim - not confirmed, see _hook; Tal's "You're Muslim?" is in. (2) "Yes" after "For free?" - one model hears a quiet yes, the other nothing; the beat ends before it. (3) "Assalamu alaikum" at the goodbye - not there; the only salaam alaikum is Tal's, at the name. The owner's last words (one model: You're welcome, have a nice day) fall while the camera has already turned to the juice machine, so the take ends on "Thank you, bro".
